hardware: pc33 NVIDIA H20-3e; Qwen3-8B bf16; torch 2.8.0+cu128

production_caliber.note: E182 K1=64 data remains historical; only the explicit same-host E182 baseline arm is used for before/after attribution.

implementation.RING_FINAL: Known static skip writes only bounded ring; no full linear owner; from_ring adopts unchanged pointers.
implementation.LINEAR_FINAL: Known non-skip writes only final linear; finalize commits metadata without KV copy.
implementation.LINEAR_PROVISIONAL: Dynamic/unknown gate writes one full linear; non-skip retains it, skip performs one disclosed linear-to-ring compaction and releases linear.
implementation.hybrid_native: B=1 row proxy writes the final batch-row view; finalize checks storage identity and drops only the proxy.
implementation.unchanged: Dense prefill returns original complete K/V; conversion arm, decode numerical path, and cross-row serial decode are unchanged.

core_regression.live_slot_targeted_rerun: 4 passed in 15.64s; direct/conversion storage comparison excludes uninitialized ring dead slots
core_regression.final_direct_hybrid_cpu_rerun: 45 passed, 7 CUDA tests deselected while formal GPU timing was active

ruler_equivalence.scope: Direct/conversion equivalence only; not an absolute or full-RULER quality claim.

e182_same_host_baseline.scope: Same-host pristine E182 vs E183, static 13/36 skip, 32K, direct graph, three requests each

memory_calibers.final_kv_ownership: Deduplicated untyped_storage physical owner bytes; views are not counted as extra owners.
memory_calibers.temporary_staging_and_finalize: Reported separately by role. Static skip has no full-linear staging; known non-skip has no staging ring; dynamic skip reports its sole compaction live bytes and destination storage.
memory_calibers.process_memory: torch.cuda allocated/max_allocated deltas with reserved/device snapshots in raw records. First request, subsequent-request prefill, whole-request peak, capture and steady decode are distinct.
memory_calibers.warning: Graph runs retain graph/workspace pools across repeated requests, so graph steady prefill peaks are not interchangeable with eager steady peaks or final KV ownership.

outlier_and_contamination_policy.rule: Quarantined files are preserved but excluded from all medians; affected cells were rerun in isolation rather than deleting only unfavorable numbers.

b32_rerun_variability.observation: The isolated rerun still encountered shared-host performance states: direct graph runs were 757.059/583.521/528.968ms and conversion graph runs were 529.195/583.902/722.240ms. Other-container GPU compute processes were visible afterward; per-step plateaus and mid-run throughput changes are retained in the verdict.
b32_rerun_variability.scope: Use the three-run medians only for direct/conversion comparison, which agrees within 0.2%; do not cite absolute B32 latency as a clean single-tenant measurement. Numerical, storage and address gates all passed in every run.

remaining_limits: Dynamic skip cannot simultaneously avoid a provisional full linear and guarantee zero finalize copy; this implementation explicitly chooses one provisional linear plus one compaction.
First-request lazy workspace and graph-pool effects are reported separately; subsequent-request eager peak savings must not be presented as first-request savings.
Hybrid row commit is fail-closed through active-builder/incomplete-length checks but does not provide a fully retryable transactional rollback after an arbitrary mid-commit exception.
Real Qwen3 hybrid runs exercise compact rows; native-dense final batch-row binding is covered by the small-model CPU direct/conversion tests at B=1/2/8/32 and dedicated storage-identity tests.
RULER is a four-sample equivalence gate only. Chunked/padded/grad/beam/offload prefill and post-finalize geometry changes remain unsupported or fail-closed.
No decode speedup is claimed: TPOT is expected to remain within same-host direct/conversion noise; decode remains row-serial in hybrid mode.
